messages:
auditor_jw: Hi — preparing SOC 2 fieldwork. Need evidence showing KMS key rotations + RBAC changes for prod and staging between 2025-11-01 and 2026-02-28. Also need audit log exports that show who approved RBAC changes and links to the PRs/ticket. Prefer a single presigned S3 bundle and a verification manifest.

maria: Hi @auditor_jw — we can produce that. Quick clarifying q's: 1) Do you want raw CloudTrail-style KMS audit events or a curated manifest w/ key IDs, rotation timestamps, and wrapped key versions? 2) For RBAC, do you need full rolebinding history diffs or just the approval evidence (tickets + approver signatures) and the terraform plan diffs?

auditor_jw: Manifest + wrapped artifacts preferred. For RBAC: approval tickets (+ approver) and the diff is fine. Also need retention policy proof for the logs and SHA256 hashes of exported objects for integrity verification.

jason: I can spin up an evidence export job that will include: kms_rotation.csv (key_id, old_version, new_version, rotated_at), audit_log_slice.jsonl (hashed), rbacs/terraform_diffs.patch, and approvals/PR_links.csv. It'll upload to s3://redwood-compliance-exports/compliance-snapshots/1768005555/ with a presign. ETA ~48 hours. If you need expedited (same-day), say so and I'll prioritise.

anita: Heads up — prod had an emergency rotation on 2026-01-15 tied to incident INC-8342 (hot key replacement). We'll include the incident write-up and vuln-triage notes. Also flag any PII redaction done on the logs.

auditor_jw: Please include the incident ticket and the reviewer signatures. For the hash chain, include KMS key IDs used to wrap the bundle and the public verification steps so we can independently confirm.

maria: We'll include a verification_manifest.txt with file-level SHA256 sums and the wrapping_key_id. We'll also attach a short script for verification. Example (will be included in the bundle):

```bash
# verify_bundle.sh
set -e
BUNDLE_DIR=$1
sha256sum -c verification_manifest.txt
# Verify envelope key used to encrypt bundle (KMS key id)
echo "Check wrapped_with_kms_key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01"
```

ops-bot: export job queued (job_id: ej-2026-03-05-09).

jason: export job started — pulling KMS audit slice from 2025-11-01..2026-02-28, RBAC diffs from infra-repo, and PR approvals from the ticketing system. Will include chain-of-custody.md describing who accessed the bundle during packaging.

ops-bot: export complete. Files uploaded to s3://redwood-compliance-exports/compliance-snapshots/1768005555/ ; presign valid for 7 days. (presign link redacted in channel)

jason: Done. @maria will DM the presign to the auditor and attach the verification manifest. Let us know if you need the raw CloudTrail export instead of the curated slice.

auditor_jw: Thanks — presign received via DM. We'll attempt verification and report back. If we need the raw logs, we'll request them explicitly. :thumbsup:
